quests.instruction: Catch the new time of the opening session.
quests.hint: Three times are mentioned for three different things. Track which one is the final plan for the session.
quests.explanation: Correct: 10:30. Nine was the original start and ten is when the speaker arrives. The organizers then set the session for ten thirty.
quests.textToSpeak: The workshop was supposed to start at nine, but the speaker called to say she'd arrive at ten. The organizers moved the opening session to ten thirty.

quests.instruction: Wipe away the fog and tap the day Sam is leaving.
quests.hint: ‘A day later’ is measured from the day already mentioned. Count forward.
quests.explanation: The answer is Tuesday. Mia leaves on Monday, and Sam leaves one day after her.
quests.textToSpeak: Mia's flying to Denver on Monday for a conference. Her colleague Sam is going with her, but he's leaving a day later.

quests.instruction: Listen for who has the keys to the storage room.
quests.hint: Listen for the person connected to the keys, not to the printer.
quests.explanation: Hannah is correct. The printer and the paper are the problem, and Hannah holds the keys to the solution.
quests.textToSpeak: The printer on the second floor is out of paper. There's more in the storage room, and the keys are with Hannah.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap what the restaurant got wrong.
quests.hint: The mistake is described with ‘by mistake’. Listen for the item and what was different.
quests.explanation: The customers wanted a large one, but they were given a small one. So the answer is the pizza size.
quests.textToSpeak: We ordered a large pizza and two salads, but the waiter brought a small pizza by mistake. He apologized and said the right one would take ten minutes.

quests.instruction: Catch where to change trains.
quests.hint: Two lines and two places are named. Listen for where the change happens.
quests.explanation: Central Station is correct. The stadium is the destination, and Central Station is where you switch lines.
quests.textToSpeak: The green line is closed for repairs until Friday. If you're going to the stadium, take the red line and change at Central Station.

quests.instruction: Wipe away the fog and tap how many tickets the speaker is selling.
quests.hint: Not all tickets are for sale. Ask how many are left over.
quests.explanation: 1 ticket is correct. The speaker has two but only needs one, because the brother can't come.
quests.textToSpeak: I bought two tickets for the Saturday show, but my brother can't come, so I'm selling one for the same price, thirty dollars.

quests.instruction: Notice what Mr. Kim will teach.
quests.hint: Each trainer has a different topic and a different time of day.
quests.explanation: First aid is correct. Safety is the morning session led by Ms. Alvarez.
quests.textToSpeak: Ms. Alvarez will lead the morning session on safety, and Mr. Kim will run the afternoon workshop on first aid.

quests.instruction: Wipe away the fog and tap when the package can be picked up.
quests.hint: The delivery time and the pickup time are different. Listen for the second.
quests.explanation: After 6:00 is correct. Noon was the failed delivery.
quests.textToSpeak: The delivery came at noon, but I wasn't home. The driver left a note asking me to pick the package up at the depot after six.

quests.instruction: Notice who is cooking this week.
quests.hint: ‘Usually’ describes the normal situation. ‘This week’ is different.
quests.explanation: The answer is Mom. Dad normally cooks, but he is away this week.
quests.textToSpeak: Dad usually cooks on weekdays, but this week Mom is cooking because Dad is traveling for work.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap when the speaker should come.
quests.hint: The original time and the new time are both said. ‘Instead’ shows the new one.
quests.explanation: Eleven was the original appointment. The doctor is behind schedule. So the answer is 11:45.
quests.textToSpeak: My appointment is with Dr. Chen at eleven, but the receptionist says she's running behind. She told me to come at eleven forty-five instead.

quests.instruction: Notice how many students must take the test again.
quests.hint: Find the difference between the whole class and the group that passed.
quests.explanation: Twenty-four minus eighteen leaves six students, the ‘rest’. So the answer is 6.
quests.textToSpeak: There are twenty-four students in the class. Eighteen passed the test, and the rest have to take it again next week.

quests.instruction: Tap where the shuttle leaves from.
quests.hint: The location comes after ‘from’. The time rules are extra information.
quests.explanation: The answer is the main entrance. After midnight, the situation changes to taxis.
quests.textToSpeak: The hotel shuttle leaves every half hour from outside the main entrance, but after midnight you have to call for a taxi.

quests.instruction: Listen for the item that you do not need at the orientation.
quests.hint: Three items are required and one is refused. Notice the negative.
quests.explanation: The old textbook is correct. The speaker says not to bring it.
quests.textToSpeak: Please bring your laptop, your charger, and the signed form to the orientation. Don't bring the old textbook, because we won't be using it.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap why the concert was moved.
quests.hint: The reason comes between the old date and the new date.
quests.explanation: The singer got sick is correct. It explains the move from the fifth to the nineteenth.
quests.textToSpeak: The concert was originally on the fifth, but the singer got sick, so it's now on the nineteenth.

quests.instruction: Catch what they will do if it rains.
quests.hint: The plan has a normal version and a backup version. You need the backup.
quests.explanation: Take the bus is correct. It replaces the walk if the weather is bad.
quests.textToSpeak: We're meeting at the café, then walking to the museum together. If it rains, we'll take the bus instead.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap when Marco joined the company.
quests.hint: Two brothers have two dates. Follow the name.
quests.explanation: July is correct. March is when Luca started.
quests.textToSpeak: Luca has been working here since March, and his brother Marco joined the company in July.

quests.instruction: Listen for what the farm shop is behind.
quests.hint: The directions mention several landmarks. The shop is connected to only one.
quests.explanation: Correct: a red barn. The gas station is only the place to turn.
quests.textToSpeak: Turn left after the gas station, drive for about five minutes, and you'll see a red barn on your right. The farm shop is right behind it.

quests.instruction: Spot how many designers are on the team.
quests.hint: Each number belongs to a role. Match number and job.
quests.explanation: The answer is 2. Six is the whole team, and three are engineers.
quests.textToSpeak: Our team has six members: three engineers, two designers, and me. I'm the manager.

quests.instruction: Listen for the day the room is booked all day.
quests.hint: Two days are mentioned. One is free and one is not.
quests.explanation: Thursday is when the room is free. So the answer is Friday.
quests.textToSpeak: Julia asked whether the room was booked for Thursday. Jamal said it was free on Thursday, but booked all day Friday.

quests.instruction: Wipe away the fog and tap how long the battery lasts at maximum brightness.
quests.hint: Each time is tied to a setting. Find the setting in the question.
quests.explanation: The answer is 6 hours. Ten hours is with the brightness turned down.
quests.textToSpeak: The battery lasts about ten hours if you turn the brightness down, but only six if you leave it on maximum.

quests.instruction: Notice how the speaker got to work last week.
quests.hint: The normal habit and last week's reality are different.
quests.explanation: The strike stopped the trains, and the speaker borrowed a car. So the answer is drove a car.
quests.textToSpeak: I usually take the train to work, but last week the trains were on strike, so I drove my neighbor's car.

quests.instruction: Find how long the mixture rests.
quests.hint: The recipe has several steps. Listen for the one that says to wait.
quests.explanation: Correct: 20 minutes. Resting is the last step in the recipe.
quests.textToSpeak: First mix the flour and the eggs. Then add the milk slowly, and leave the mixture to rest for twenty minutes.

quests.instruction: Focus on where Anna works.
quests.hint: Two sisters, two workplaces. Pay attention to who is being described.
quests.explanation: Correct: an insurance company. The emergency room is the sister's workplace.
quests.textToSpeak: Anna's sister works as a nurse in the emergency room, but Anna prefers office work, so she works for an insurance company.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap what is worse on the new phone.
quests.hint: Two improvements are listed. ‘But’ introduces the drawback.
quests.explanation: Correct: the battery. The screen and the camera are better, but the battery is smaller.
quests.textToSpeak: The new phone has a bigger screen and a better camera, but the battery is smaller than the old one.

quests.instruction: Focus on when the store opens on Sundays.
quests.hint: Three days, three different times. Match Sunday to its time.
quests.explanation: Eight is for weekdays, and nine is for Saturdays. So the answer is 11:00.
quests.textToSpeak: The store opens at eight on weekdays. On Saturdays it opens at nine, and on Sundays it doesn't open until eleven.

quests.instruction: Clear the glass and tap why there's no need to rush.
quests.hint: The reason follows ‘so’ and connects to the client.
quests.explanation: The client reads it on Monday is correct. It explains why the weekend is not urgent.
quests.textToSpeak: The manager wants the report finished by Thursday, but the client won't read it until Monday, so there's no need to rush over the weekend.
quests.targetDetail: the client reads it on Monday
options: the client reads it on Monday

quests.instruction: Tap how many said they can come.
quests.hint: The numbers get smaller step by step. Choose the last one.
quests.explanation: 25 is correct. Forty were invited, thirty replied, and twenty-five said yes.
quests.textToSpeak: We invited forty people, but only about thirty replied, and twenty-five said they can come.

quests.instruction: Focus on the platform the train actually leaves from.
quests.hint: The original platform and the new platform are both said. The sign tells you the final one.
quests.explanation: The answer is 8. Platform three was the first plan, and the sign changed it.
quests.textToSpeak: The train was supposed to leave from platform three, but the sign now says platform eight, so we ran across the station.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap why Ravi is joining the meeting.
quests.hint: ‘Because’ introduces Ravi's purpose. Listen to what follows.
quests.explanation: Ravi comes from finance to talk about it. So the answer is to discuss the budget.
quests.textToSpeak: It's a meeting for the marketing team, but Ravi from finance is joining us because he wants to talk about the budget.

quests.instruction: Listen for what the speaker gets to keep.
quests.hint: The company fixes a mistake in two ways. Listen for the one that is free.
quests.explanation: The black one is coming tomorrow, but the gray one stays free of charge. So the answer is the gray backpack.
quests.textToSpeak: I ordered a black backpack, but they sent a gray one. They're sending the right one tomorrow, and I can keep the gray one for free.
